images.caption: Figure 1:Performance of OvisOCR3 across benchmarks for OCR-related tasks.

Figure 2:Two-stage cross-page table reconstruction with a shared model. Page-level parsing produces Markdown with HTML tables; reconstruction uses these representations together with adjacent page images to identify continuations and recover complete tables.

Figure 3:Recursive reconstruction of a table spanning three pages. After merging the fragments on pages 2 and 3, the updated Markdown for page 2 is re-rendered and paired with page 1. Colors denote the source pages of the table fragments. Each step uses two page images and their current parsed representations.
(a)Document page.

Figure 5:An example of a four-image figure group from DocFigCapBench. The red outline marks one evaluation target; the blue outlines mark its four annotated members.

Figure 6:An annotated two-page example from CrossTabBench. Red boxes mark fragments of the same table, with enlarged views below the source pages. The ground-truth reconstruction on the right preserves merged cells and numerical values.
Figure A.1:Structured document parsing with predicted region boundaries, semantic categories, and rendered page content.
Figure A.2:Document layout detection. Box colors denote predicted region categories; numeric labels indicate reading order.
Figure A.3:Markdown document parsing, with text in reading order and mathematical expressions rendered from LaTeX.
Figure A.4:Markdown parsing of a photographed document with page deformation and uneven illumination.
Figure A.5:Markdown parsing of a photographed document affected by low light and perspective distortion.
Figure A.6:Markdown document parsing of a Japanese page.
Figure A.7:Plain OCR on a comic page, transcribing speech-balloon text in reading order.
Figure A.8:Word-level text spotting. Each of the five recognized words is paired with a predicted bounding box.
Figure A.9:Reference grounding for the supplied wordAUTOMOBILE, returning its bounding box.
Figure A.10:Region OCR on a specified paragraph, excluding surrounding text from the response.
Figure A.11:Formula recognition with LaTeX output and its rendered matrix expression.
Figure A.12:Chart parsing with metadata and per-category values organized as JSON. Numerical values are serialized as strings.
Figure A.13:Text translation from Chinese to English within the selected region.
Figure A.14:Image classification of ASCII art. The response selectsbasketballfrom the supplied candidate labels.
Figure A.15:Visual question answering from a book cover, with a brief explanation followed by the author’s name as the final answer.
Figure A.16:Position-aware VQA on a yellow sign. The response pairs the answer text with its predicted bounding box.

Figure A.17:Open extraction from a CC-OCR[2]receipt. The model extracts item amounts and payment totals using keys drawn from the receipt, without a supplied field list or JSON template. Blurring is present in the source image.

Figure A.18:Specified-field extraction from an OCRBench v2[1]registration form. The response contains exactly the five requested keys. Missing applicant telephone and fax values remain empty, rather than being filled with the organizer’s contact details.

Figure A.19:Schema-based extraction from a CC-OCR[2]receipt. Each item’s name, quantity, and price are grouped in one record; the total amount, cash payment, and change are stored in a separate nested object. Blurring is present in the source image.
Figure A.20:Comparison on a page with multiple visual regions.
Figure A.21:Comparison on a photographed magazine page.
Figure A.22:Comparison on a page with two charts.
Figure A.23:Comparison on a newspaper page with individual images and an image group.
Figure A.24:OvisOCR3 generates a caption and a Mermaid representation for an algorithm flowchart. The other 14 records in the full-page response are omitted from this display.
Figure A.25:OvisOCR3 generates a caption and a Mermaid representation for a device block diagram. The other 18 records in the full-page response are omitted from this display.
Figure A.26:OvisOCR3 generates a caption and a Mermaid representation for a system architecture diagram. The other 45 records in the full-page response are omitted from this display.

Figure A.27:Cross-page correlation table from MPDocBench-Parse (document pages 4–5). The FDI label spans two rows separated by the page boundary. Full pages and enlarged fragments show the source structure; FigureA.28compares the reconstructions.

Figure A.29:Cross-page financial table from MPDocBench-Parse (document pages 6–7). The currency unit at the start of the second page completes the cash-flow label on the first page. Full pages and enlarged fragments show the source structure; FigureA.30compares the reconstructions.
